data.name: Aniket
data.gender_notes: Aniket is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ani (unique) + Ket (lord). The name Aniket carries the meaning “Lord of the Unique” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aniket usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the unique and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the unique self, individuality, and inner strength.
data.etymology: Aniket belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Unique.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aniket total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aniket carries a unique and powerful significance in Hindu culture as it signifies an individual who possesses a unique characteristics, a leader or someone who stands out amongst their peers. The name reflects one's strength, individuality, and leadership qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aniket highlights the inner divine presence of an individual as a unique manifestation of God. It emphasizes the concept of loving God, as an individual, with unique offerings and devotion, while reminding us of our innate spiritual uniqueness and inherent worth in the eyes of the divine.

historical_references.reference: Aniket was a legendary king of Haihayas, who ruled over Mathura in the 10th century BCE. He is mentioned in the Mahabharata, an Indian epic.
Aniket, also known as Aniketaka, was a Jain Tirthankara. He is believed to have lived in the 12th century BCE in the Indian subcontinent.
